transcript.text:
Hi there! I'm Ava, an AI recruiting assistant for Harbor Logistics. Thanks for applying for our Warehouse Operator role in Getafe! 

This quick screening call takes about five minutes, and your answers will be saved for our recruiting team, who make all the final decisions. Could you please tell me your name and if you're ready to get started?
Hi Ava! Yes, I'm Marta Diaz, and I'm definitely ready to get started. Before we begin, could you tell me how much this Warehouse Operator role pays?

sentiment.reason: The candidate is calm and enthusiastic about starting.

transcript.text:
Great to meet you, Marta! 

To answer your question, the pay is 1,580 euros gross per month, in 14 payments a year, and Saturday shifts in peak season are paid at 1.5 times the normal rate. 

To kick things off with our questions, do you have a valid permit to work in Spain?
That pay rate sounds great, thank you. Yes, I have a valid permit to work in Spain and am fully authorized to work here.

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive and answers the question politely.

transcript.text:
Perfect, thanks for confirming that, Marta! 

This role has rotating morning and afternoon shifts, Monday to Friday. Which of these shifts are you able to work?
I'm fully available for both morning and afternoon shifts. I was actually wondering, are there also night shifts available for this role, or is it only those two?

sentiment.reason: The candidate is calm, positive, and asking about night shifts.

transcript.text:
Got it, thanks! 

To answer your question, there are no night shifts for this role—it is just the weekly rotating morning and afternoon shifts. 

When would you be able to start working with us?
That's good to know about the shifts, thanks for clarifying. I am available to start immediately, as soon as you need me!

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive, cooperative, and eager to start.

transcript.text:
That's fantastic! Immediate availability is always great. 

Can you reliably commute to the Getafe logistics park in Madrid, especially for that 6:00 AM morning start?
Yes, I can absolutely commute to Getafe reliably. I have my own transport, so the 6:00 AM start won't be a problem for me at all.

sentiment.reason: The candidate is positive and confirms their availability.

transcript.text:
That's perfect, having your own transport makes it so much easier! 

Now, I'd love to hear a bit about your experience. Could you tell me about a time you had to finish work with a team under time pressure? What did you do?

Last Christmas at the supermarket where I worked, two delivery trucks arrived really late. I split our team into pairs so we could work more efficiently, and we managed to unload everything before the store opened.

sentiment.reason: The candidate provides a calm and detailed answer about teamwork.

transcript.text:
That sounds like a very busy shift, great job taking the initiative there! 

Could you tell me about a time you noticed a safety risk or a mistake at work? What did you do about it?
Once I noticed a pallet leaning dangerously near one of the emergency exits. I immediately stopped work in that area and reported it to my supervisor, and we got it safely restacked right away.

sentiment.reason: The candidate calmly and clearly answers the interview question.

transcript.text:
Thanks for sharing that, Marta. Safety is definitely our top priority here, so that's great to hear. 

We'd love to invite you to a 30-minute video interview with our warehouse manager. Would Wednesday, November 11th at 10:00 AM or Thursday, November 12th at 12:30 PM work for you?
Before we book that, I have one more question: is it allowed to bring my dog to work with me? If that's okay, I would like to choose the Thursday, November 12th slot at 12:30 PM.

sentiment.reason: The candidate asks a calm question and selects a slot.

transcript.text:
I don't have that detail about the dog policy, but the manager will be able to answer that for you during the interview. 

Shall we go ahead and book that Thursday slot at 12:30 PM?
Yes, please go ahead and book that. Thursday, November 12th at 12:30 PM works perfectly for me. Thank you so much, Ava!

sentiment.reason: The candidate is agreeable, polite, and confirms the interview slot.

transcript.text: Perfect. Your video interview with the warehouse manager is booked for Thursday 12 November at 12:30. Your reference is INT-797666. You will get the details by email. Thank you for your time, and good luck!
